_comment: Category curation rules, applied to TRUE amenity counts from source geometry.
Originally generated by curate_categories.py --reconcile to reproduce the
published 44-category set; since extended with categories that qualify under
the same rule but were never routed by the old Valhalla pipeline.
min_amenity_count=25 keeps 41 of the published 44 outright. The three
force_keep entries are exceptions the published set retained below that
threshold; they were an undocumented judgement call and still need a stated

_force_drop_reasons.leisure+picnic_table: Passes the count threshold (32) but is street furniture, not a destination service. Nobody selects a neighbourhood on picnic-table access, so it is not a meaningful accessibility amenity.

_merges_note: Cross-file duplication is handled upstream instead: build_grid_routed.py
assigns each osm_id to exactly one category (the largest candidate), so a
bakery appearing in both food+drink and shops+food is counted once, under
shops+food+bakery. That subsumes what merge rules were previously needed for,
and also fixes pre-existing overlap in the published set
Populate this block only for genuine semantic grouping, not deduplication.

_added_beyond_published._note: Qualify under min_amenity_count on true counts but were never routed by the old pipeline. Counts shown are pre-deduplication.
_added_beyond_published.Doctor'sOffice+doctors: 85 - primary-care tier absent from the published set entirely
_added_beyond_published.shops+food+marketplace: 53 - traditional markets, directly relevant to lower-income profiles
_added_beyond_published.shops+food+tea: 52 - tea retailers (OSM shop=tea), not informal chai stalls

_excluded.food+drink+bakery: all 29 features duplicate shops+food+bakery; removed by osm_id dedup
